method: Original PNGs with no resampling were measured. Tight manually recorded crops exclude labels/grid. White wave ink requires each RGB channel >95. Median ink y at each x defines the path; its own sampled min/max define amplitude and the first/last ink x define phase. Reset midpoint lies halfway between max/min median-column positions. Segment statistics exclude outer 8% and central 20%. Shapes reflect schematic UI, not audio waveform or sample-phase accuracy; these are descriptive measurements without an acceptance threshold.
